title: The Last Salt Anew
premise: In the salt-locked valley of Vess, where magic cannot cross the white flats, Theo Iversen has spent her life as a temple scribe hiding the gift she was born with. When crown hunters arrive seeking anyone touched by magic, her secret is exposed by the one person she trusts, forcing her to flee into a kingdom where winter is falling unnaturally early and the young king is slowly being consumed by an ancient entity bound to his crown. Guided by a band of outcasts who become her found family, Theo learns that unbinding the king requires sacrificing either her own gift or the truth that could free them all. In the end she chooses truth over safety, shattering the binding at the cost of her invisibility forever, and returns to Vess not as a hidden scribe but as the valley's first openly gifted guardian.
about_author: Petra Nystrom is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval land charters before turning to fantasy. She writes about people trapped by systems they never chose, from a farmhouse on the Norwegian coast.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. We meet her copying temple ledgers in Vess, trading small acts of quiet magic for silence, until her closest friend Maren betrays her name to the arriving crown hunters to save her own family. Theo flees across the salt flats as the first impossible snow falls. Emotional beat: the shattering of the belief that staying small keeps you safe.

chapters.title: A Crown of Borrowed Winter
chapters.summary: Theo's POV, joined by outcasts: a disgraced hunt-captain, a mute child with the same gift, and a defected court physician. They reach the capital and discover the king is a hollowed vessel, his will eaten by the entity in his crown, which feeds the endless winter. The physician reveals unbinding requires a willing bearer of the gift. Emotional beat: reluctant loyalty forming among strangers.

chapters.title: What the Salt Refuses
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Infiltrating the palace during the solstice feast, Theo confronts the entity directly and learns it offers her a bargain: her survival and Maren's pardon in exchange for becoming its new vessel. The hunt-captain dies holding the door, and Theo realizes the entity's power runs on secrets kept. Emotional beat: the climax, choosing truth over the bargain.

chapters.title: The Last Salt Anew
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Speaking the binding aloud before the assembled court, she breaks the entity's hold; the crown cracks, the king wakes diminished but human, and the winter begins to thaw. She carries the mute child home to Vess, where Maren waits in shame and forgiveness is uncertain but possible. Emotional beat: resolution—found family, truth accepted, a new kind of belonging.
